svg.title: Your first request in the Picard workspace
svg.desc: In Requests, write a title and input, review and approve one call, then follow its state. In Jobs, reopen the saved answer and review it. Preparing or reading an answer does not call the model; an uncertain call is not automatically retried.

g.text: Jobs: reopen and review the answer
A saved draft does not call the model.
Check the exact input and limits first.
You can leave and return to its link.
Reading or downloading makes no new call.
Uncertain outcome? Preserve it; do not retry automatically.
Generated code is a proposal, not an executed change.
